about_short_description.short_description: Rewatch offers a private and secure video channel for teams.

product.name: AI Meeting Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered tool that automatically records meetings, transcribes them, generates summaries, action items, and searchable transcripts to enhance team collaboration and productivity.

product.name: Video Hub
product.description: A centralized platform to store, organize, search, and share all team videos, including meeting recordings and async updates, with features like transcripts, comments, and document attachments.

product.name: Screen Recorder
product.description: A tool to record asynchronous video updates with screen capture and camera overlay, enabling teams to share visual information without live meetings.

product.name: Mobile App
product.description: iOS and Android applications that enable users to watch, record, share videos, and collaborate with their team on the go.

product.name: Lucid Integration
product.description: An integration that embeds Rewatch videos into Lucidchart and Lucidspark documents and boards, linking visual collaboration with video content for enhanced project alignment.
